We at PAHA Animal Rescue, are a No Kill Shelter & Charity. We rescue abused, lost and stray dogs and find them new happy homes! 

Please support our cause at: www.panafricasa.org

If you like what we do please  consider a small donation on our webpage. Don't forget to share, like and subscribe!
#dogs #cats #animals #animalrescue #charity
